reviewBasis: The 117 Bun identities were checked title by title against the eight focused test sources; the dynamic U0-LIM, U0-THRESH, U0-TOPO, and U0-MENU-TOPO rows were also checked against the independently reviewed primitive-state matrix IDs, limit keys, and subjects.

The 30 Playwright specifications were checked title by title against the fourteen reviewed owner sources, then expanded only across the exact chromium, firefox, and webkit project matrix pinned in playwright.config.ts.

The 28 cell templates, their producer titles, ordered case and trace bindings, and 48 screenshot basenames were checked against every writeU0EvidenceCell, u0Binding, and captureU0Screenshot call in the reviewed browser owner sources.

Historical JUnit and Playwright artifacts were consulted as drafting and discrepancy aids, but were not accepted as authority for pass status, product behavior, bindings, screenshots, or production output; the checked-in source and fixture hashes are the review boundary.
